mapper.select: SELECT ST_X(chosen.point) AS representative_longitude, ST_Y(chosen.point) AS representative_latitude, chosen.layer_key AS representative_layer_key, chosen.extent_kind AS representative_extent_kind FROM ( SELECT sm.layer_key, sm.extent_kind, CASE WHEN ST_Dimension(part.geom) = 1 THEN ST_LineInterpolatePoint(part.geom, 0.5) ELSE ST_PointOnSurface(part.geom) END AS point FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_spatial_metadata sm CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_Dump(sm.geographic_extent) AS part WHERE sm.file_meta_id = #{id} AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(part.geom) ORDER BY ST_Dimension(part.geom) DESC, CASE ST_Dimension(part.geom) WHEN 2 THEN ST_Area(part.geom::geography) WHEN 1 THEN ST_Length(part.geom::geography) ELSE 0 END DESC, sm.layer_key COLLATE "C", part.path LIMIT 1 ) chosen

WITH source AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT fm.data_set_id, fm.id AS file_id, sm.extent_kind,
ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(sm.geographic_extent, #{tolerance}) sm.geographic_extent AS geographic_extent FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_spatial_metadata sm JOIN ocean_gis.gis_file_meta fm ON fm.id = sm.file_meta_id WHERE fm.deleted = 0 AND fm.file_status = 'READY' AND fm.metadata_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fm.data_set_id IN #{id} ), prepared AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT source.*,
ST_ReducePrecision(geographic_extent, #{tolerance}) geographic_extent AS preview_extent FROM source ), bounded AS ( SELECT prepared.*,
CASE WHEN ST_XMin(Box3D(preview_extent)) < -180 OR ST_XMax(Box3D(preview_extent)) > 180 OR ST_YMin(Box3D(preview_extent)) < -90 OR ST_YMax(Box3D(preview_extent)) > 90 THEN ST_Intersection(preview_extent, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -90, 180, 90, 4326)) ELSE preview_extent END AS bounded_extent FROM prepared ), merged AS ( SELECT data_set_id, COUNT(DISTINCT file_id) AS source_file_count, COUNT(*) AS source_layer_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT extent_kind) = 1 THEN MIN(extent_kind) ELSE 'MIXED' END AS extent_kind,
ST_Union(CASE WHEN ST_IsEmpty(bounded_extent) THEN geographic_extent ELSE bounded_extent END) AS geographic_extent FROM bounded GROUP BY data_set_id ) SELECT data_set_id, source_file_count, source_layer_count, extent_kind, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_ForcePolygonCCW(
ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(geographic_extent, #{tolerance}) geographic_extent
), 15, 0) AS geo_json FROM merged ORDER BY data_set_id
mapper.sql: deleted = 0 AND file_status = 'READY' AND (metadata_status = 'QUEUED' OR (metadata_status = 'RUNNING' AND metadata_lease_expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET metadata_status = 'QUEUED', metadata_lease_expires_at = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND file_status = 'READY' AND metadata_status = 'WAITING' AND ingest_progress_id = #{progressId} AND metadata_lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET metadata_status = 'FAILED', metadata_lease_expires_at = NULL, metadata_version = metadata_version + 1, metadata_error_code = 'INGESTION_INTERRUPTED', metadata_error_message = '数据接入已中断，请删除失败记录后重新录入', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND metadata_status = 'WAITING' AND metadata_lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta SET metadata_status = 'RUNNING', metadata_version = metadata_version + 1, representative_longitude = NULL, representative_latitude = NULL, representative_layer_key = NULL, representative_extent_kind = NULL, metadata_lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND RETURNING *

SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE id = #{id} AND metadata_version = #{version} AND metadata_status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted = 0 AND file_status = 'READY' AND metadata_lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: WITH previous AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_meta WHERE data_set_id = #{dataSetId} AND file_status = 'READY' AND extension IN ('tif', 'tiff') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE ) UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_file_meta fm SET metadata_status = CASE WHEN fm.metadata_status = 'WAITING' THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'QUEUED' END, metadata_version = fm.metadata_version + 1, representative_longitude = NULL, representative_latitude = NULL, representative_layer_key = NULL, representative_extent_kind = NULL, metadata_lease_expires_at = CASE WHEN fm.metadata_status = 'WAITING' THEN fm.metadata_lease_expires_at ELSE NULL END, metadata_error_code = NULL, metadata_error_message = NULL, metadata_extracted_at = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM previous p WHERE fm.id = p.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_file_spatial_metadata (id, file_meta_id, layer_key, layer_name, data_kind, source_crs_code, source_crs_wkt, source_unit, source_extent, geographic_extent, extent_kind, raster_width, raster_height, band_count, resolution_x, resolution_y, resolution_unit, tile_matrix_set_id, tile_width, tile_height, recommended_max_zoom, calculation_details, extra_metadata) VALUES (#{item.id}, #{item.fileMetaId}, #{item.layerKey}, #{item.layerName}, #{item.dataKind}, #{item.sourceCrsCode}, #{item.sourceCrsWkt}, #{item.sourceUnit}, CAST(#{item.sourceExtent} AS jsonb), ST_GeomFromText(#{item.geographicExtent}, 4326), #{item.extentKind}, #{item.rasterWidth}, #{item.rasterHeight}, #{item.bandCount}, #{item.resolutionX}, #{item.resolutionY}, #{item.resolutionUnit}, #{item.tileMatrixSetId}, #{item.tileWidth}, #{item.tileHeight}, #{item.recommendedMaxZoom}, CAST(#{item.calculationDetails} AS jsonb), CAST(#{item.extraMetadata} AS jsonb))
mapper.select:
SELECT sm.id, sm.file_meta_id, sm.layer_key, sm.layer_name, sm.data_kind, sm.source_crs_code, sm.source_crs_wkt, sm.source_unit, sm.source_extent::text AS source_extent,
ST_AsText(sm.geographic_extent) NULL AS geographic_extent, sm.extent_kind, sm.raster_width, sm.raster_height, sm.band_count, sm.resolution_x, sm.resolution_y, sm.resolution_unit, sm.tile_matrix_set_id, sm.tile_width, sm.tile_height, sm.recommended_max_zoom, sm.calculation_details::text AS calculation_details, sm.extra_metadata::text AS extra_metadata, ST_XMin(Box3D(sm.geographic_extent)) AS west, ST_YMin(Box3D(sm.geographic_extent)) AS south, ST_XMax(Box3D(sm.geographic_extent)) AS east, ST_YMax(Box3D(sm.geographic_extent)) AS north FROM ocean_gis.gis_file_spatial_metadata sm JOIN ocean_gis.gis_file_meta fm ON fm.id = sm.file_meta_id AND fm.metadata_status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE sm.file_meta_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sm.file_meta_id, sm.layer_key
